Commit 20f03a431 changed no test results that I could find, but I only compared part of the suite.

The commit touched `src/core/store/mark.ts` and `test/store/open.test.ts`. The comparison covers only those two paths, not the whole repo.

- **`test/store/open.test.ts`:** unchanged, with the same result at `a5c9b7223` and at HEAD. The commit added 27 lines to this file, so I did not compare the new test cases against the old file's results.
- **Rest of `test/store/`:** the result at `a5c9b7223` was still running when I looked. Squeal reported 0 pass→fail, 0 fail→pass, 3 unchanged and 36 with no earlier result yet. Every file in the folder passes at HEAD, so nothing there is known to have gone red.
- **Everything else:** the comparison against the earlier commit is still pending. It was queued for 1,338 test files and had finished about 90 when I stopped. I did not run the other 624 files that the change doesn't select.

One failure turned up at HEAD, in `test/cli/group-pending-release.test.ts` ("reads the new pending answer without error"). It is probably not caused by this commit. The error says no `squeal--v*` tag is an ancestor of HEAD, which points to missing git tags in this checkout. Squeal has no earlier result for it, so it cannot confirm that. `git fetch --tags` should fix it.

`squeal status --at HEAD~1 --wait 100000` will wait for the rest. The full comparison takes about 8 minutes, and I can wait for it if you want a definitive answer.
